ifYou: Ukuba ibinguwe, akukho nto ufuneka uyenze.
secureHelp: Iqhosha livula iphepha apho unokukhetha iphasiwedi entsha. Emva koko, vula i-Vaultara, uye ku-Iprofayile > Ukhuseleko nobumfihlo > Izixhobo zakho uze ucofe u-Phuma kwezinye izixhobo zonke.
support: Phendula le imeyile okanye uqhagamshelane ne-{supportEmail}.
securityFooter: Sithumela le imeyile ukuze sigcine iakhawunti yakho ye-Vaultara ikhuselekile. Akunakuzicima ezi imeyile.
billingFooter: Sithumela le imeyile ukuze uhlale usazi okwenzekayo ngobhaliso lwakho lwe-Vaultara.
newSignInBody: Kusandul ukungenwa kwiakhawunti yakho ye-Vaultara kusetyenziswa isixhobo esingazange sasibona ngaphambili.
passwordChangedBody: Iphasiwedi yeakhawunti yakho ye-Vaultara isandul ukutshintshwa.
emailChangeRequestedBody: Kwenziwe isicelo sokutshintsha i-imeyile ekwiakhawunti yakho.
emailChangeRequestedBodyTo: Kwenziwe isicelo sokutshintsha i-imeyile ekwiakhawunti yakho ibe ngu-{maskedNewEmail}.
twoStepDisabledBody: Ukungena ngamanyathelo amabini kusandul ukucinywa kwiakhawunti yakho ye-Vaultara. Ngoku ukungena kufuna iphasiwedi yakho kuphela.
sessionsRevokedBody: Iakhawunti yakho ye-Vaultara isandul ukuphuma kuzo zonke izixhobo ngaphandle kwesi sisetyenziswe ukwenza olu tshintsho.
includedPremium: I-Premium iquka iirekhodi neecandelo ezingenamda, iifoto ezincanyathiselweyo, amakhonkco okwabelana nezikhumbuzo eziphambili.
includedFamily: Usapho luquka yonke into ekwi-Premium, kunye neerekhodi nezikhumbuzo ekwabelwana ngazo zekhaya lakho lonke.
includedBusiness: Ishishini liquka yonke into ekuSapho, kunye nezikhumbuzo zabasebenzi, izicelo zohlaziyo neengxelo zokuthobela imithetho.
receiptGoogle: I-Google Play ikuthumelela irisithi esemthethweni enexabiso elihlawulisiweyo.
receiptApple: I-Apple ikuthumelela irisithi esemthethweni enexabiso elihlawulisiweyo.
startedBody: Enkosi ngokubhalisa. Isicwangciso sakho se-{plan} ngoku siyasebenza.
renewedBody: Isicwangciso sakho se-{plan} sihlaziyiwe. Enkosi ngokuhlala ne-Vaultara.
yearlyReminderSubject: Isicwangciso sakho se-Vaultara {plan} siza kuhlaziywa kwiintsuku ezi-7
yearlyReminderBody: Isicwangciso sakho sonyaka se-{plan} siza kuhlaziywa ngomhla we-{date}. Ukuba ufuna ukusigcina, akukho nto ufuneka uyenze. Ukuba ufuna ukusitshintsha okanye ukusirhoxisa, ungakwenza oko phambi komhla wohlaziyo.
cancelledBody: Ukuhlaziya ngokuzenzekelayo ngoku kucinyiwe kwisicwangciso sakho se-{plan}. Uhlala unofikelelo olupheleleyo kude kube ngu-{date}. Emva koko, iakhawunti yakho iya kwisicwangciso sasimahla kwaye iirekhodi zakho zihlala zikhuselekile.
resumedSubject: Isicwangciso sakho se-Vaultara {plan} siza kuhlaziywa kwakhona
resumedBody: Ukuhlaziya ngokuzenzekelayo kuvuliwe kwakhona kwisicwangciso sakho se-{plan}. Enkosi ngokuhlala ne-Vaultara.
endedBody: Isicwangciso sakho se-{plan} siphelile kwaye iakhawunti yakho ngoku ikwisicwangciso sasimahla. Iirekhodi zakho zisekwiakhawunti yakho. Ungabhalisa kwakhona nangaliphi na ixesha kwi-app.
refundedBody: Ukuthenga isicwangciso sakho se-{plan} kubuyiselwe imali. Ufikelelo obuze nokuthenga oku luphelile.
deleteBody: Sifumene isicelo sokucima iakhawunti ye-Vaultara esebenzisa le dilesi ye-imeyile. Ukuze uqhubeke, vula ikhonkco elingezantsi. Ungajonga okuza kucinywa phambi kokuba uqinisekise.
deleteExpiry: Ikhonkco lisebenza kanye kwaye liphelelwa lixesha kwiyure e-1.
deleteNotYou: Ukuba awukhange ucele oku, ungayihoya le imeyile. Iakhawunti yakho ihlala injengoko injalo.
deleteFooter: Sithumela le imeyile kuba umntu othile ucele ukucima iakhawunti ye-Vaultara yale dilesi.
